timing_scope: New portable-package qualification with concurrent Hub upload/host workload; archived headline timings are unchanged. No independent physical-memory polling by this driver.
publication_scope: Complete requests, full outputs, original normalized SSE lines/events/frames, actual token metrics, readiness snapshots, source/native identities and sanitized report provenance. Service configs, API keys, private server logs and incomplete r2 task jobs are excluded.

caveats: The original all-suite r2 invocation failed after both completed core jobs, when a bulk-NAX log assertion was incorrectly required for a 1344-token task below the 2048-token dispatch floor. The invocation-status.json remains failed; incomplete r2 task artifacts are excluded from this core export.

Old asynchronous cache deletion generated 31 SSD ENOENT ERROR lines across the two core logs. These core requests still explicitly used zero cached tokens and passed complete output/geometry/native/identity checks; this export does not claim clean SSD persistence for r2. The later writer-drain fix was exercised by r3 task/prefix jobs, not this core run.
Native-group/NAX availability preflight and stable SSD-writer drain/readiness run outside request timers. Both jobs passed; their private logs contain zero ERROR/ENOENT lines.
